question: In a certain code language if COMMITAL is written as ACILMMOT, then how will INTEGRAL be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea82bd5c97415b6a0bb4a31c9208d4af49dfee9c43ef8ee84e3fd4a2b56e847.png] 

The logic followed here is:

The letters of CAMMITAL are written in **alphabetical order** i.e. ACILMMOT.

Hence, the letters of INTEGRAL will be written in** ****alphabetical order** i.e. AEGILNRT

Hence, **"option 4"** is the correct answer
